exposure: Location (provincial capital city vs. county-level city)
outcome: Maternal demand for termination of pregnancy
cohort: 401 pregnant women from two hospitals of different grades in two cities in China
finding: Pregnant women in China frequently experienced anxiety, depression, and insomnia during the Omicron pandemic, with higher rates in the provincial capital city and a positive correlation with COVID-19 infection severity.
mod_finding: COVID-19 infection had no appreciable impact on maternal demand for cesarean section.
